dataset.generation: Array.from(size, i => ({ id: `option-${i}`, value: `value-${i}`, label: `Option ${i}` })) in the browser
dataset.estimatedItemHeight: Calibrated per browser session from one built-in option before timed trials.

protocol.legacy100kPolicy: Run one bounded feasibility probe after the 1k/10k workload matrix and before 100k virtual trials; if censored, skip its remaining warmups/repetitions. If feasible, apply the same timeout bound to each legacy warmup/repetition and skip the remainder after any censor.
protocol.scrolling: Deterministic seeded random-access seeks; target indexes are identical between render modes for each size and repetition.
protocol.gc: Chromium CDP Runtime.getHeapUsage snapshots around each trial; HeapProfiler.collectGarbage before baseline and after removing the select and dropping benchmark data references.
protocol.percentileInterpretation: Event-level pooled scroll percentiles and the distribution of per-trial p95 values are reported separately. A per-trial p95 is not a cross-repetition percentile.
protocol.measurementType: Exploratory unless at least one warm-up and five measured repetitions are present for a feasible workload; no performance budget is enforced by this harness.

skippedWorkloads.reason: separately bounded legacy scalability probe was censored before full render settled

browserDiagnostics.interpretation: Counts are recorded per attempted workload. Browser-process stderr is preserved by the Playwright test log on test failure and is not inferred from page-event counters.
